description: Na₄ReN₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N³⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.99 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three N³⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.45 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four N³⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaN₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.61 Å. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four N³⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaN₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.59 Å. Re⁵⁺ is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three N³⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Re-N bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.82 Å. There are three inequivalent N³⁻ sites. In the first N³⁻ site, N³⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and one Re⁵⁺ atom. In the second N³⁻ site, N³⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and one Re⁵⁺ atom. In the third N³⁻ site, N³⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Re⁵⁺ atom to form distorted corner-sharing NNa₅Re octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°.
